home.title: Gear up before you head topside
home.lede: Weapons, mods and blueprints. Buy without an account, make a transfer and we hand it over in a match together.

pick.title: Pick and fill in your details
pick.text: Your Discord username, email and Embark ID. No account needed.

book.title: Transfer
book.text: We show you the account holder, CBU/alias and the exact amount. Keep the receipt.

room.title: Join our Discord
room.text: Send your receipt in the delivery channel with your order number.

play.title: Get your item
play.text: We confirm the payment, add you in game and hand it over in the match.

discord.title: Our Discord
discord.lede: Deliveries are arranged here: send your receipt in the delivery channel and we will contact you for the match.

rules: Staff never message you first in DMs.
The price is always the one on your appointment ticket.
Only the admin named on your ticket will serve you.
If anyone asks you to pay outside of what is shown, tell us in #support.
